questions.question: Write a C program to demonstrate the use of function pointer and explain step by step. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Program demonstrating function pointer Function pointers allow calling functions dynamically – 2 marks Program – 6 Step by step explanation – 2 marks #include void display(int n) { printf("Number: %d\n", n); } int main() { void (*fp)(int); // function pointer declaration fp = display; // assigning function address fp(10); // calling function through pointer return 0; }

questions.question: Write a C program to check whether a given string is a palindrome or not. / [CO2] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html: • Program to check palindrome string Program with correct logic but with errors – 8 marks Logically correct program without errors – 10 marks (Input – 3, Process – 5, Output – 2) #include #include int main() { char str[100]; printf("Enter a string: "); gets(str); int len = strlen(str), flag = 1; for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) { if (str[i] != str[len - i - 1]) { flag = 0; break; } } if (flag) printf("Palindrome"); else printf("Not a palindrome"); return 0; }
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
